Email.footer: Spirit of Santa · Kids earn gifts with good deeds. You got this email because someone used this address on Spirit of Santa.
Email.ignore: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Nothing will change.
Email.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Spirit of Santa
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Thanks for signing up your store on Spirit of Santa. Please confirm this is your email address.
verifyEmail.expiry: This link works once and expires in 24 hours.

accountExists.subject: You already have a Spirit of Santa account
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.body: Someone tried to sign up with this email address, but it already has an account. You can sign in, or reset your password if you've forgotten it.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Spirit of Santa password
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We got a request to reset the password for this email address.
resetPassword.expiry: This link works once and expires in 1 hour.

inviteOwner.subject: You're invited to list your store on Spirit of Santa
inviteOwner.heading: Your store is invited
inviteOwner.body: Spirit of Santa has invited {storeName} to list gift items for local kids. Set your password and accept the store agreement to get started.
inviteOwner.expiry: This link works once and expires in 7 days.

storeApproved.subject: {storeName} is approved on Spirit of Santa
storeApproved.heading: Your store is approved
storeApproved.body: Good news: {storeName} is approved. Families can now see your store and items. Sign in to manage your item list.

storeRejected.subject: About your Spirit of Santa application
storeRejected.heading: Application not approved
storeRejected.body: We weren't able to approve {storeName} at this time. Reason: {reason}. If you have questions, contact the Spirit of Santa team.

inviteRep.subject: You're invited to help run a store on Spirit of Santa
inviteRep.heading: Join your store's team
inviteRep.body: You've been invited to help manage {storeName}'s gift items on Spirit of Santa. Choose your name and password to get started.
inviteRep.expiry: This link works once and expires in 7 days.

mfaEnabled.subject: Two-step sign-in was turned on for your admin account
mfaEnabled.heading: Two-step sign-in is on
mfaEnabled.body: Two-step sign-in (an authenticator app) was just turned on for your Spirit of Santa admin account. If this was you, there's nothing else to do. If it wasn't you, someone knows your password: contact the Spirit of Santa team right away so the account can be locked and reset.

verifyParentEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Spirit of Santa
verifyParentEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyParentEmail.body: Thanks for creating a family account on Spirit of Santa. Please confirm this is your email address. After that you can sign in and add your children.
verifyParentEmail.expiry: This link works once and expires in 24 hours.

donationReceipt.subject: Your donation receipt from {orgName}
donationReceipt.heading: Thank you for your gift

storeOrders.subject: Spirit of Santa gift orders for {storeName}
storeOrders.heading: Gift orders

giftOnItsWay.subject: A gift is on its way!
giftOnItsWay.heading: A gift is on its way
giftOnItsWay.body:
Good news! {kidName}'s gift, {itemName}, is on its way from Spirit of Santa.

Thank you for helping {kidName} earn it with good deeds.

familyDigest.subject: Today's magic on Spirit of Santa
familyDigest.heading: Good news from today
familyDigest.deeds: {count, plural, one {# good deed thanked} other {# good deeds thanked}}

cutoffReminder.subject: Wish lists freeze on {date}
cutoffReminder.heading: Wish lists freeze soon
cutoffReminder.body:
On {date} every wish list freezes for Christmas: after that, gifts can't be added or removed.

This is a good moment to check your children's lists with them.

payUpReminder.subject: Last days to finish gifts: until {date}
payUpReminder.heading: Finish gifts before {date}
payUpReminder.body: Some gifts on your children's lists aren't fully funded yet. You can pay what's missing until {date}. Gifts still unfinished at the season's close drop off the list, and the Christmas Magic on them goes to Spirit of Santa.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Spirit of Santa password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for this Spirit of Santa account was just changed using a reset link, and every device was signed out. If this was you, there's nothing else to do. If it wasn't you, reset your password again right away and contact the Spirit of Santa team.

accountDeleted.subject: Your Spirit of Santa family account was deleted
accountDeleted.heading: Your family account was deleted
accountDeleted.body: As you asked, we deleted your Spirit of Santa family account: your children's names, birth years, good deeds and wish lists, your delivery address and your sign-in. Any Christmas Magic left went to Spirit of Santa to help other children. We keep only payment and donation records with no names, as the law requires. If you didn't ask for this, contact the Spirit of Santa team right away.
